method.edge_source: R01 p5 Eq.(12) paragraph: 8 bins in [4,8]; R01 p7 Fig.1 left; R02 p6 Fig.5 upper

method.nominal_choice_reason: R02 dashed nominal gives 0.66008..1.18689 keV, consistent with R01 p5 footnote 3 (~0.66..1.19)
method.efficiency: Total(US2) from original formal archive, piecewise linear and applied once; already contains ROI
method.resolution: ignored, as explicitly stated in R01 p5 after Eq.(12)
method.Jacobian: Integrated over inverse-mapped T edges, exactly equivalent to dR/dNe=dR/dT*dT/dNe; no extra Jacobian
method.accepted_domain_diagnostic: Integrate full tabulated Total(US2) T domain separately, report outside-mean-window counts; no rescaling
